snippet.title: KEYKRUNCHER™ Publisher Announcement Trailer | CRTime
snippet.description:
KEYKRUNCHER™ is the fun and effective treatment for all your keyboard-eating needs! Look down, follow the monitor, KLICK the correct KEY, and KRUNCH. Earn enough Compliance Points before IT eats you. Coming soon to PC and XBOX Series X|S.

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4887630/KEYKRUNCHER/
